prompt: At a pizza shop, the number of toppings $X$ a customer orders has this distribution: $P(X = 1) = 0.2$, $P(X = 2) = 0.5$, $P(X = 3) = 0.3$. Find the mean $\mu_X$. Round to the nearest tenth.
hint: The mean of a discrete random variable is $\sum x \cdot P(x)$ — value times probability, summed.

hints.text: The mean of a discrete random variable is $\sum x \cdot P(x)$ — value times probability, summed.

explanation: Multiply each value by its probability: $1(0.2) = 0.2$, $2(0.5) = 1.0$, $3(0.3) = 0.9$.
So $\mu_X = 2.1$ toppings. It need not be a whole number — it is a long-run average.

alternativeExplanations.title: Picture 10 customers
steps: Among 10 typical customers, 2 order one topping, 5 order two, 3 order three.
